author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA override: kd=23 micro (k=50, δ=0.12, emb_k=17, γ_max=0.70)
abstract: Companion micro-ablation setting kdensity to 23 (vs. 22) with the exact frozen config (λ=0.605, δ=0.12, k=50, emb_k=17, γ_max=0.70). Complements kd=21 to bracket kd sensitivity; non-binding—baseline remains frozen unless ≥0.744.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.12,
        kdensity=23,
        k_total=50,
        emb_n_neighbors=17,
        gamma_max=0.70,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
